audience: agencies that take client work requests and invoice their clients in ManyRequests

useCases.title: Review open requests for one client
useCases.text: List requests filtered by client, status or due date, then open one request to see its assignees and counts.

useCases.title: Read the discussion on a request
useCases.text: List the comments on a request, internal or client-visible, and the time entries logged on it.

useCases.title: Check unpaid invoices
useCases.text: List invoices filtered by client, organization or status, then open one invoice to read its payment reference.

useCases.title: Review recurring services of an organization
useCases.text: List the services the portal runs, then the recurring subscriptions of one organization with their status.

useCases.title: Open a request for a client
useCases.text: Create a service request for a client with a title. The client's portal shows the request once it is created.

useCases.title: Add a comment to a request
useCases.text: Add an internal comment for the team, or a comment the client can see, to one request.
